Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a 127 year old man receiving the world record for oldest human to ever live. Later that night, in bed, he recalls a theory he read on the internet in his youth, \"Quantum Immortality\" he then proceeds to have a mental breakdown.\n Write the entire response in title case (capitalize the first letter of every major word).assistant
response:
FADE IN:

INT. RECORDS OFFICE - DAY

The room is filled with officials, reporters, and cameras. A large banner reads "WORLD RECORD HOLDER" in bold letters. At the center of the room, a frail but determined 127-year-old man, GEORGE, stands proudly, his eyes shining with tears. He is presented with a certificate and a gold medal.

GEORGE
(overcome with emotion)
I... I don't understand. I'm just a simple man from a small town. I never thought I'd be here.

REPORTER 1
(congratulating George)
Mr. George, you are the oldest human to ever live. Your remarkable longevity has left the scientific community in awe.

GEORGE
(smiling weakly)
Thank you. I'm just grateful to have made it this far.

The officials and reporters continue to congratulate George as he is presented with a trophy and a standing ovation.

CUT TO:

INT. GEORGE'S BEDROOM - NIGHT

George lies in bed, his eyes fixed on the ceiling. He looks old and tired, but his mind is still sharp. He begins to think back to his youth, when he was fascinated by the internet and its endless possibilities.

GEORGE
(to himself)
I remember reading about this theory... Quantum Immortality. It said that if you lived long enough, you would eventually become immortal.

George's eyes glaze over as he becomes lost in thought.

GEORGE
(whispering)
What if it's true? What if I'm already immortal?

Suddenly, George's expression changes. His eyes widen in terror, and his face contorts in anguish.

GEORGE
(panicked)
No, no, no! It can't be! I'm not immortal! I'm just a man!

George's body begins to shake, and he starts to sob uncontrollably. He throws off the covers and gets out of bed, pacing back and forth across the room.

GEORGE
(pleading with himself)
Please, no! I don't want to be immortal! I don't want to live forever!

As the night wears on, George's mental state deteriorates further. He becomes convinced that he is trapped in some kind of never-ending nightmare, and that he will never be able to escape.

GEORGE
(desperate)
What if I'm stuck in this never-ending cycle? What if I'm doomed to live forever?

George's cries of despair echo through the empty room, as he descends into a deep and abiding madness.

FADE TO BLACK.

FADE IN:

EXT. GEORGE'S HOUSE - DAY

The next morning, George's family and friends find him catatonic in his bed, his eyes frozen in a permanent stare. They try to rouse him, but he doesn't respond.

GEORGE'S DAUGHTER
(concerned)
Dad, what's wrong? What's happening to you?

George's family and friends are left to wonder what has driven their beloved patriarch to the brink of madness.

FADE TO BLACK.
